blogs.title: QLoRA: Turning 65B LLMs into a One‑GPU Wonder
blogs.description: Dive into the core breakthrough of QLoRA – how a simple 4‑bit quantization and LoRA adapters unlock the ability to fine‑tune an entire 65‑billion‑parameter model on a single 48 GB GPU. The post explains the memory‑saving tricks, the underlying math behind NF4, and why this is a game‑changer for researchers and hobbyists alike.

blogs.title: From Integers to NormalFloat: Why NF4 Outperforms 4‑Bit Floating Point
blogs.description: Explore the information‑theoretic design of NormalFloat (NF4) and how it gives LLM weights a natural distribution fit. Readers will see concrete performance gains over traditional FP4/Int4 quantization on tasks like GLUE, MMLU, and language modeling, plus practical guidance on implementing NF4 in PyTorch.

blogs.title: Double Quantization & Paged Optimizers: The Secret Sauce Behind 4‑Bit Training
blogs.description: Learn how double quantizing the per‑block scaling constants saves another 0.37 bits per weight, and how NVIDIA’s unified memory paging keeps optimizer states from blowing out GPU RAM. The article walks through the trade‑offs and shows why these tricks enable stable training of gigantic models.

blogs.title: Guanaco vs. ChatGPT: What We Learned from Head‑to‐Head Elo Tournaments
blogs.description: A deep dive into the new automated GPT‑4 evaluation protocol and tournament‑style Elo scoring used in the paper. Readers discover how Guanaco’s 65 B version climbs to ~99 % of ChatGPT on Vicuna, what the Elo scores really mean, and where even state‑of‑the‑art chatbots still fall short.

blogs.title: Instruction Fine‑Tuning at Scale: Lessons from 1,000+ Models
blogs.description: Recount the ambitious experiment that fine‑tuned 1,000+ LLMs across 8 datasets and multiple architectures. The post discusses dataset quality vs size, the orthogonality between MMLU and chatbot benchmarks, and practical takeaways for anyone building instruction following models.

blogs.title: Quantization + LoRA = Near Full FP Performance – Why It Works
blogs.description: "Can a quantized base model ever match full precision when fine‐tuned?" See how backpropagating through frozen NF4 weights fully recovers lost performance on everything from RoBERTa to LLaMA up to 65 B parameters.
